description: Source code for handling OVSDB update requests and monitoring, including parsing update notifications, managing monitor callbacks, and detecting changes in database fields.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_start
methods.description: Initializes parsing of an OVSDB update request, verifying the JSON object and setting up the parser structure.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_next
methods.description: Advances the parser to the next update request, iterating over tables, rows, and extracting 'new' and 'old' data.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_monitor_ex
methods.description: Starts monitoring an OVS table with specified columns and flags, registering callback for updates.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_monitor
methods.description: Shorthand wrapper to start monitoring an OVS table with default flags.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_monitor_call_cbk
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a JSON-RPC update call, verifies method, extracts table data, and processes it.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_monitor_resp_cbk
methods.description: Handles the response to the monitor request, processing update messages or handling errors.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_monitor_process
methods.description: Processes an update message, parsing it and determining the type of change (insert, modify, delete).

methods.name: ovsdb_update_monitor_error
methods.description: Resets monitor state and invokes callback on error.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_changed
methods.description: Checks if a specific field has changed in the latest update, comparing old and new JSON data.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_type_to_str
methods.description: Converts an update type enum to its string representation.
